topic: Mage in World of Warcraft: Forever (beta capped at level 30; launch Nov 4, 2026)
overview:
Forever keeps the Mage as a pure ranged magic-DPS class: three DPS specs, no tank or heal role. Blizzard's stated goal (official Mage and Shaman deep dive, Oct 7, 2026) is to make each school "more active moment-to-moment". The idea is to pick the right spell for the moment. Frost layers control, Fire builds toward heavy crits and timing, and Arcane amplifies the rest of the toolkit. Talents give each school a stronger identity and more room for cross-school builds.

Frostfire Bolt exists. It is officially a new baseline spell learned at level 40, with a 3 s cast. It counts as both Fire and Frost, deals Fireball-like upfront damage plus a DoT and a slow, and uses the higher of the Mage's Fire or Frost spell damage against the lower of the target's two resistances. Blizzard built it for hybrid Frost/Fire builds, for example Ignite plus Ice Shards giving a 280% crit.

Arcane changes the most. It goes from a Classic support tree to a real spec built on new talents: Arcane Blast (11-point gold medal, redesigned Oct 15 to stack +15% of Intellect as spell damage), Missile Barrage (free, double-speed Arcane Missiles, now a row-1 talent) and Arcane Wrath (16-point gold medal, scales with max mana).

Fire gets Heating Up. Crits from Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast and Scorch cut Pyroblast's cast time, stacking 3 times down to 1.5 s. Ignite is now a separate debuff for each Mage, and Improved Scorch only helps the Mage who cast it. The "Wake of Fire" talent was reverted to Improved Fire Blast on Oct 15.

Frost gets Ice Lance (11-point gold medal, +200% damage vs Frozen) and Fingers of Frost. Shatter no longer needs Improved Frost Nova. Winter's Chill now powers up Cone of Cold. Ice Block is now the 16-point gold medal and Cold Snap the 21-point one (10 min cooldown). Frost Blast (level 24) replaces down-ranked Frostbolt.

Mass AoE farming was deliberately weakened: shorter Cone of Cold, Improved Blizzard capped at a 40% slow, and a down-ranking penalty on damage and procs.

There is also a new Mage-only minor tradeskill, Comprehension. Its spell, Comprehend Scroll, deciphers scrolls dropped in the world into buffs, weapon imbues, familiars and damage consumables. Food and water, teleports and portals, Polymorph, Counterspell and Remove Lesser Curse (now also removes Banes) all remain. Nobody has played level 60 yet, so every level-60 rotation is unknown or speculative.

specs.name: Arcane
specs.identity: This is the biggest change from Classic. Arcane goes from a support tree to a spec that manages and spends mana. Arcane Blast builds stacking spell damage (15% of Intellect per cast, 4 stacks, 15 s) while its own mana cost rises 175% per stack. Missile Barrage procs turn Arcane Missiles into a free channel at double speed. Arcane Wrath (3.5 s cast, 6 s cooldown) gains spell power equal to 5% of max mana. Arcane Explosion is the AoE. Icy Veins says mana management gives Arcane a layer of complexity the other two specs lack. Reported weaknesses: the least control and survivability of the three, very mana-hungry, and RNG on Missile Barrage.
keyNewTalents: Arcane Blast (11-point gold medal, new spell; redesigned Oct 15)
Missile Barrage (new; moved to row 1 as a 2-point talent on Oct 15)
Arcane Wrath (new 16-point gold medal, Oct 15)
Arcane Geometry (new row-3 talent: +6 yd Arcane range)
Improved Channeling (formerly Improved Arcane Missiles; also protects Arcane Blast/Arcane Wrath casts)
Arcane Impact (formerly Improved Arcane Explosion; +crit on all Arcane spells)
Arcane Shielding (formerly Improved Mana Shield; also boosts Mage Armor resistances)
Arcane Mind (redesigned: +Intellect and +Arcane crit damage)
Arcane Meditation (more regen while casting; now requires Arcane Concentration)
Improved Counterspell (always silences instead of a chance)
specs.level60Rotation: Unknown. No source has a level-60 Arcane rotation; the beta caps at 30. Level-30 beta loop per Icy Veins, Wowhead and Warcraft Tavern: pull with Frostbolt when solo (snare); cast Arcane Blast 1-3 times (Wowhead: no more than 2 stacks except on bosses, to save mana); cast Arcane Missiles whenever Missile Barrage procs; if nothing procs after 2-3 Blasts, spend the stacks on Fire Blast or Arcane Explosion; finish low targets with the wand. AoE: Arcane Explosion spam (pre-cast Flamestrike if mana allows), or Blizzard from range. Arcane Wrath (added Oct 15) is not yet in any guide rotation. Speculative (wowtbc.gg, Frost guide): even Frost may keep a 1-stack Arcane Blast buff up and spend Missile Barrage procs.
specs.rotationStatus: Level 30: reported-guide / beta-observation. Level 60: unknown. Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath changed on Oct 15, after most guides were written.

specs.name: Fire
specs.identity: A crit-driven glass cannon. Ignite (now a separate debuff for each Mage) and Heating Up (crits shorten the next Pyroblast's cast, 3 stacks down to 1.5 s) define it. Guides report the strongest burst AoE (Flamestrike, Blast Wave), with a high risk of pulling threat. At level 40, Frostfire Bolt lets Fire take Frost talents (Ice Shards, Elemental Precision, Shatter) and hit Fire-resistant enemies. Guides say it is weak at low levels or in low gear because crit is scarce, and scales very well.
keyNewTalents: Heating Up (new row-4 talent requiring Pyroblast; called 'Hot Streak' until Oct 1)
Incineration (moved to row 1; now also boosts Ice Lance and Arcane Blast crit)
Improved Fire Blast (briefly redesigned as 'Wake of Fire', reverted Oct 15; -2 s cooldown, +15 yd range)
Improved Fireball (now also speeds up Frostfire Bolt)
Fire Power (redesigned Oct 15: 3 ranks, +1-3% per Fire effect on the target, up to 12%)
Ignite (now a separate debuff for each Mage; no damage lost when crits land close together)
Improved Scorch (debuff only benefits the caster)
Critical Mass (5 ranks, 10%)
Combustion (back to 3 charges)
specs.level60Rotation: Unknown. Mobalytics' level-60 gameplay tab only says it will be updated as launch approaches, and Icy Veins and Warcraft Tavern have no level-60 Fire content. Level-30 beta loop (Icy Veins, Wowhead, Warcraft Tavern): pre-cast Pyroblast; Scorch x5 on high-health targets to stack Improved Scorch; Fireball as filler (Icy Veins: Frostfire Bolt replaces Fireball from level 40); Pyroblast once Heating Up reaches 3 stacks; Fire Blast on cooldown (it always adds a Heating Up charge). AoE: Flamestrike > Blast Wave > Arcane Explosion. Guide expectations only: Icy Veins expects Improved Scorch to be mandatory at 60, and Combustion is the 31-point capstone.
specs.rotationStatus: Level 30: reported-guide / beta-observation (Wowhead says Heating Up does not feel fluid). Level 60: unknown.

specs.name: Frost
specs.identity: Control and safety. Chills and Freezes come built into the damage loop. Frostbolt and Frost Blast chill; Frostbite and Fingers of Frost proc; Ice Lance (instant, +200% vs Frozen) cashes in procs and also works while moving. Shatter (+50% crit vs Frozen) and Ice Shards make those hits big. Winter's Chill now stacks up to 5 times to empower Cone of Cold. Defensives: Ice Block (16-point), Cold Snap (21-point, 10 min cooldown), Ice Barrier (31-point capstone, gives pushback protection). Guides call it the main leveling and PvP spec: the safest and most consistent, but not top of the damage meters, and dependent on RNG procs.
keyNewTalents: Ice Lance (new 11-point gold medal talent; Frozen bonus cut to +200% from 300% on Oct 15)
Fingers of Frost (new row-5 talent, 1/2 charges, requires Ice Lance)
Shatter (3 ranks, no longer requires Improved Frost Nova)
Ice Block (moved to row 4; now the 16-point gold medal)
Cold Snap (moved to row 5; 21-point gold medal; cooldown 10 min)
Winter's Chill (redesigned: no longer adds crit; now empowers the next Cone of Cold; personal only)
Improved Blizzard (max slow 40%, was 65%)
Permafrost (chill duration +11/22/33%)
Elemental Precision (now +hit for Fire and Frost)
specs.level60Rotation: Unknown. Speculative only: wowtbc.gg calls its list 'an idea' pending sims: keep Mage Armor up; maintain Ice Barrier; Cone of Cold at 5 Winter's Chill stacks; Ice Lance with Fingers of Frost procs; maintain 1 Arcane Blast stack; Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage; Frostbolt as filler; Ice Lance while moving. Level-30 loop (Icy Veins, Wowhead, Warcraft Tavern): spam Frostbolt; on a Fingers of Frost proc, cancel the cast and Ice Lance; on a Frostbite freeze, queue Ice Lance behind the next Frostbolt (spell batching lets both Shatter); Ice Lance while the target stays frozen; Cone of Cold to consume 5 Winter's Chill stacks; Frost Nova then back off while Ice Lancing. AoE 3+: Cone of Cold to fish procs, then Ice Lance; 5+: Cone of Cold on cooldown plus Blizzard, or Arcane Explosion if you hold aggro.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.description: Datamined, 12 ranks (1/6/12/.../60), 35 yd. R1: 15-23 Fire damage plus 2 over 4 s. R12: 437-553 plus 60 over 8 s (Classic 596-760 +76); damage lowered roughly 6-35% across ranks. Oct 8 dev notes adjusted ranks 1-5. Can proc Missile Barrage and Heating Up.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.description: Unchanged from Classic per datamine. Ranks at 1/10/20. +30 armor at R1 (200 at R3). Melee attackers may be slowed 30% with attack time +25% for 5 s; 30 min duration; only one Armor at a time. The slow is a Chill, so it can proc Frostbite and Fingers of Frost (fixed Oct 15).

abilities.name: Arcane Intellect
abilities.description: 5 ranks (1/14/28/42/56). +2 Intellect at R1, +31 at R5. Lasts 1 hour (Classic: 30 min).

abilities.name: Conjure Water
abilities.description: 7 ranks (4/10/20/30/40/50/60). Now conjures 20 drinks per cast (Classic 10). Conjured items vanish after 15+ min logged out. Tradeable; guides note players tip for food and water.

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.description: 11 ranks (4..60), 30 yd. R1: 18.8-20.8 damage, 40% slow for 5 s. R11: ~470-506 damage, 40% slow for 9 s (Classic 515-555). Its guaranteed Chill procs Frostbite and Fingers of Frost. Down-ranking penalty: R1 Frostbolt at 60 has a 0% Frostbite chance (official).

abilities.name: Conjure Food
abilities.description: 7 ranks (6/12/22/32/42/52/60). Now 20 items per cast (Classic 10). Guides note Forever adds well-fed buffs from real food, so Mages still carry cooked food for the buff.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.description: 7 ranks (6..54), 20 yd base. R1: 27-35 damage; R7: 417-489 (Classic 446-524). Instant finisher with no travel time. Always grants an extra Heating Up charge (a Fire Blast crit gives 2). Improved Fire Blast reduces cooldown and adds range.

abilities.name: Comprehend Scroll
abilities.description: Official: the ability used for the new Mage-only minor tradeskill Comprehension, found in the General tab of the spellbook. It reads and deciphers scrolls dropped by creatures in the world; Blizzard says benefits are 'various', left for players to discover. Guides: learned at level 6. Skill breakpoints 1/15/50/175 (Method). Failing turns you into a sheep (Warcraft Tavern). Scrolls became uncastable while moving (Oct 1) and now trigger the global cooldown (Oct 15).

abilities.name: Arcane Missiles
abilities.description: 8 ranks (8..56). R1: 25 damage per second for 3 s. R8: 213 per second for 5 s (Classic 230). Line of sight is now checked once at the start of the channel (official, Sept 24). With Missile Barrage it costs no mana, channels in half the time and fires every 0.5 s. Improved Channeling gives 100% pushback protection.

abilities.name: Polymorph
abilities.description: Unchanged per datamine. Ranks trained at 8/20/40/60. Turns the target into a sheep for up to 50 s; it cannot attack or cast and regenerates quickly; any damage breaks it. One target at a time; Beasts, Humanoids and Critters only. 30 yd. Wowhead also lists Turtle/Pig/Cow variants at 60.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: 4 ranks (10/26/40/54). Damages nearby enemies (R1 21.5-23.5, R4 ~72-79, slightly up from Classic) and freezes them in place for up to 8 s; damage may break the freeze. Icy Veins: 10 yd radius, 100% freeze; save it for emergencies in groups.

abilities.name: Dampen Magic
abilities.description: 5 ranks (12..60); values up ~50% vs Classic. R5 reduces spell damage taken by up to 135 and healing by up to 270. Lasts 10 min. No longer procs Clearcasting (Oct 15).

abilities.name: Slow Fall
abilities.description: Unchanged. Slows falling speed for 30 s.

abilities.name: Arcane Explosion
abilities.description: 6 ranks (14..54). Hits all enemies within 10 yd. R1 32-36, R6 239-258 (Classic 249-270). The main AoE for every spec, especially when tanked; usable while moving. Icy Veins: no damage falloff by target count.

abilities.name: Flamestrike
abilities.description: 6 ranks (16..56), 30 yd ground target. R1: 55-71 plus 44 over 8 s; R6: 384-468 plus 332 over 8 s. New restriction: only one Flamestrike active per Mage. Guides use it as a pre-cast opener on tanked packs.

abilities.name: Amplify Magic
abilities.description: 4 ranks (18/30/42/54), values ~+50%. R4 raises spell damage taken by up to 113 and healing by up to 225. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Remove Lesser Curse
abilities.description: Removes 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target, 30 yd (Classic: Curse only). The Mage's decurse; 'Bane' appears to be a new Forever debuff type.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Teleports 20 yd forward unless blocked and frees the caster from Stuns and Immobilizes; tooltip reworded only. Icy Veins: used on cooldown while running it is roughly a 20% travel-speed boost.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: 6 ranks (20..60). R1: 196 Frost damage over 8 s; R6: 1184 (Classic 1192). Chills only with Improved Blizzard, now capped at 40% slow. Breaks if pushed back heavily; guides use it from range in groups.

abilities.name: Evocation
abilities.description: Unchanged. While channeling, mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500% for 8 s. Icy Veins: restores most of the mana pool; usable in combat; use it regularly in dungeons and raids.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.description: Unchanged. 6 ranks (20..60). Absorbs 120 (R1) to 570 (R6) physical damage, draining 2 mana per point absorbed; lasts 1 min. Arcane Shielding reduces the drain. Shields protect casts from pushback (Icy Veins).

abilities.name: Fire Ward
abilities.description: 5 ranks (20..60). Absorbs 162 (R1) to 913 (R5) Fire damage for 30 s. Improved Fire Ward adds a reflect chance.

abilities.name: Teleport: Stormwind / Ironforge / Orgrimmar / Undercity
abilities.description: Unchanged. Taught by each city's Portal Trainer near the Mage trainer. Faction cities at 20; Teleport: Darnassus / Thunder Bluff at 30. Icy Veins: the rune costs a flat 10 silver. Guides advise not setting your Hearthstone to a city you can teleport to.

abilities.name: Frost Ward
abilities.description: 5 ranks (22..60). Absorbs [162 + 10% of Frost spell power] Frost damage at R1 for 30 s; now scales with spell power. Frost Warding adds a negate chance and +absorb.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.description: 7 ranks (22..58), 30 yd. R1: 38-46; R7: 170-200 (Classic 237-280, about 28-37% lower). Applies Improved Scorch's Fire vulnerability (stacks to 5, caster only). Can proc Heating Up.

abilities.name: Counterspell
abilities.description: Unchanged. 30 yd. Counters the cast and locks that school for 10 s; generates high threat. Improved Counterspell adds a guaranteed 2/4 s Silence.

abilities.name: Frost Blast
abilities.description: Official (Oct 15): new spell learned at 24. Deals damage and slows movement by 40%. Affected by all talents that affect Frostbolt. Replaces the old trick of down-ranked R1 Frostbolt, with a higher mana cost and slightly more damage. Datamine: 3 ranks (24/36/48), R1 28-31 Frost damage, slow lasts 9 s. Can proc Missile Barrage and Winter's Chill.

abilities.name: Cone of Cold
abilities.description: Official: duration decreased to stop gold farmers and boosters kiting huge packs. Oct 15: the first 4 targets hit get an extra 10% slow and 3 s more duration. Datamine: 5 ranks (26/34/42/50/58); R1 ~96-106 damage; 40% slow for 6 s, first 4 targets +10% for +3 s (Classic 50% for 8 s). It is the Winter's Chill payoff spell.

abilities.name: Conjure Mana Agate / Jade / Citrine / Ruby
abilities.cooldown: gem use has a cooldown (duration not stated)
abilities.description: Unchanged. Agate at 28 (restores 375-425 mana), Jade at 38 (550-650), Citrine at 48 (775-925), Ruby at 58 (1000-1200). Wowhead L30: Agate is not tuned for Forever's higher spell costs.

abilities.name: Ice Armor
abilities.description: Unchanged. 4 ranks (30/40/50/60). +290 armor and +6 Frost resistance at R1 (560/15 at R4), plus the Frost Armor chill on attackers. Replaces Frost Armor.

abilities.name: Mage Armor
abilities.description: Official: its mana regeneration bonus from Spirit was increased. Datamine: 3 ranks (34/46/58); +5 resistance to all magic at R1 (15 at R3); lets 50% of mana regeneration continue while casting (Classic 30%); 30 min. Warcraft Tavern: at 34 it greatly cuts downtime in long fights.

abilities.name: Frostfire Bolt
abilities.description: Official: new spell at 40 that counts as both a Fire and a Frost spell; most talents for either school also apply. Big upfront damage like Fireball plus a debuff with a DoT and a slow. Uses the higher of your Fire or Frost spell damage and the lower of the target's two resistances. Meant for hybrid Frost/Fire builds; example Ignite + Ice Shards = 280% crit. Datamine: 3 ranks (40/50/60), 35 yd; R1 103-118 damage, 40% slow, +27 over 9 s; R3 286-331 +57. Improved Fireball speeds it, Missile Barrage and Heating Up proc from it, Fire Power boosts it but it adds no Fire Power stack.

abilities.name: Portal: Stormwind / Ironforge / Orgrimmar / Undercity
abilities.description: Unchanged. Creates a portal that sends group members to the city. Taught by city Portal Trainers; Portal: Darnassus / Thunder Bluff at 50. Icy Veins: the fastest way to travel in Forever (fast travel is limited) and players often tip. The Legacy talent Reagent Economy makes teleports and portals free.

abilities.name: Teleport: Dalaran
abilities.description: New datamined teleport to Dalaran (Forever has a City of Dalaran dungeon/location). Wowhead says level 50; the Icy Veins Frost leveling table says 40 (conflict).

abilities.name: Arcane Brilliance
abilities.description: Now trainable at 56 (not a talent-gated book drop) and buffs the target's party and raid (Classic: party only): +31 Intellect for 1 hour, 40 yd.

abilities.name: Magic Attunement (now baseline)
abilities.description: Official: moved from the Arcane talent tree to baseline. Its Forever effect is not described. Wowhead notes Arcane Geometry takes its old talent slot.

abilities.name: Detect Magic (removed)
abilities.description: Listed as 'Not in Forever' in the datamined spellbook (Classic level 16).

abilities.name: Wand Specialization
abilities.description: Official: now only 2 points for the same benefit, +13% / +25% wand damage. Note that wands no longer gain damage from spell damage (Sept 24) and need a 0.5 s stand-still (Oct 15). Guides take it early, then respec.

abilities.name: Arcane Focus
abilities.description: Redesigned: now raises hit chance with Arcane spells, 1% per rank up to 5% (Classic: reduced resist chance up to 10%).

abilities.name: Improved Channeling
abilities.description: Formerly Improved Arcane Missiles; also protects Arcane Blast. Datamine at 5/5: Arcane Missiles 100% and Arcane Blast/Arcane Wrath 70% chance to lose no cast time when hit.

abilities.name: Missile Barrage
abilities.description: New. First the 16-point gold medal (Oct 7); on Oct 15 moved to row 1 as a 2-point talent, and Arcane Missiles hits can now also proc it. Arcane Blast, Fireball, Frostbolt and Frostfire Bolt can proc it, with double the chance on Arcane Blast. Datamine at 2/2: Arcane Blast 40%, and 20% for Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, Frost Blast and Frostfire Bolt. The next Arcane Missiles channels 50% faster, costs no mana and fires every 0.5 s.

abilities.name: Arcane Subtlety
abilities.description: Moved to row 2; slightly more resistance ignored, slightly less threat reduction. Datamine at 2/2: target resistance -15 against all your spells, Arcane threat -30% (Classic -10 / -40%).

abilities.name: Magic Absorption
abilities.description: Now a 1 s internal cooldown. Datamine: 2 ranks, +5/+10 all resistances; fully resisted spells restore 1%/2% of max mana.

abilities.name: Arcane Concentration
abilities.description: 2-10% chance for Clearcasting after a damage spell hits; the next damage spell costs 100% less mana. Official: lower proc chance from spells far below your rank (anti proc-fishing). Oct 15 fixes: no longer rolls per target hit, procs from Dampen/Amplify Magic, or procs out of combat.

abilities.name: Arcane Resilience
abilities.description: Moved from row 3 to row 2; no longer a gold medal talent; now 2 points for the same effect: armor equal to 25% / 50% of Intellect.

abilities.name: Arcane Geometry
abilities.description: New row-3 talent: +3 / +6 yd range on Arcane spells (guides: 36 yd pulls).

abilities.name: Arcane Impact
abilities.description: Formerly Improved Arcane Explosion; now +2/4/6% crit chance on all Arcane spells.

abilities.name: Arcane Blast
abilities.description: New 11-point gold medal talent spell. Redesigned Oct 15: 1.5 s cast; each cast grants 15% of Intellect as extra spell damage and raises Arcane Blast's mana cost; stacks 4 times; lasts 15 s from first application (no longer ends on the next cast); damage and coefficients -40%. The Oct 7 version (2.5 s cast, buffed other spells, ended when any other spell was cast) is superseded. Datamine: 5 ranks (20/30/40/50/60), R1 34-38 damage.

abilities.name: Arcane Shielding
abilities.description: Formerly Improved Mana Shield. Larger Mana Shield cost reduction, plus higher Mage Armor resistances. Datamine at 2/2: mana lost per damage -33%, Mage Armor resistances +50%.

abilities.name: Improved Counterspell
abilities.description: Slight redesign: always applies a shorter Silence instead of a chance. Datamine: 2 s / 4 s Silence (Classic: 50/100% chance of 4 s). Icy Veins: essential for PvP.

abilities.name: Arcane Meditation
abilities.description: Spirit regen while casting increased; now requires 5/5 Arcane Concentration. Datamine: 17% / 33% / 50% of mana regen continues while casting (Classic 5/10/15%).

abilities.name: Arcane Wrath
abilities.description: New 16-point gold medal talent (Oct 15). Base damage similar to Fireball, but deals damage as if you had extra spell power equal to 5% of max mana. Datamine: requires Arcane Blast; talent tooltip 122-146 damage; spellbook ranks at 36/48/60 (194-231 up to 439-529). Benefits from Improved Channeling; can proc Missile Barrage.

abilities.name: Presence of Mind
abilities.description: Unchanged tooltip: the next Mage spell with a cast under 10 s becomes instant. Oct 15 fixes: now consumed correctly, and Heating Up is no longer consumed by a PoM Pyroblast. Arcane Power now requires it.

abilities.name: Arcane Mind
abilities.description: Redesigned: raises Intellect instead of max mana and adds Arcane crit damage; no longer requires Arcane Resilience. Datamine at 5/5: +10% Intellect, +100% Arcane crit damage bonus.

abilities.name: Arcane Instability
abilities.description: No longer requires Presence of Mind (official). +1/2/3% spell damage and crit.

abilities.name: Arcane Power
abilities.description: 31-point capstone; now requires Presence of Mind (official). For 15 s, spells deal 30% more damage and cost 30% more mana.

abilities.name: Improved Fire Blast (briefly 'Wake of Fire')
abilities.description: Oct 7: renamed Wake of Fire and moved to row 1, with a big Fire Blast crit boost after killing a non-trivial target (buff extended to 30 s on Sept 24). Oct 15: reverted to Improved Fire Blast; no kill bonus; +8/15 yd Fire Blast range. Calculator at 2/2: -2 s cooldown, +15 yd. Icy Veins overview/Fire prose still describe the outdated Wake of Fire.

abilities.name: Incineration
abilities.description: Formerly Incinerate; moved from row 3 to row 1. Now +2/4/6% crit on Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast and Scorch.

abilities.name: Improved Fireball
abilities.description: Now also cuts Frostfire Bolt's cast time: -0.1 to -0.5 s on Fireball and Frostfire Bolt.

abilities.name: Ignite
abilities.description: Fire crits burn for an extra 8-40% of the damage over 4 s. Now a separate debuff for each Mage (Classic Era: shared); no damage lost when crits land close together. Sept 24: no longer double-dips on % damage modifiers.

abilities.name: Flame Throwing
abilities.description: Unchanged: +3/+6 yd range on Fire spells (guides: 41 yd pulls).

abilities.name: Impact
abilities.description: Fire spells have a 3-10% chance to stun for 2 s (3 ranks). Lower chance from low-rank spells (official). Oct 8: no longer procs from Flamestrike's periodic damage. Icy Veins: essential for Fire PvP.

abilities.name: Burning Soul
abilities.description: Now 3 points for the same effect: 70% pushback protection on Fire spells and -30% Fire threat at 3/3.

abilities.name: Improved Flamestrike
abilities.description: Unchanged: +5/10/15% Flamestrike crit.

abilities.name: Pyroblast
abilities.castTime: 6 s (down to 1.5 s with 3 Heating Up stacks)
abilities.description: 11-point Fire talent spell, 35 yd. Talent tooltip: 101-131 Fire damage plus 44 over 12 s; spellbook ranks up to 547-674 + 212 (Classic 716-890 + 268). Used as a pre-pull opener and as a rotation nuke once Heating Up is stacked. Blast Wave no longer requires it.

abilities.name: Improved Scorch
abilities.description: 33/66/100% chance on Scorch to apply Fire vulnerability: +3% Fire damage from you per stack, 5 stacks, 30 s. The debuff now benefits only the casting Mage (official) and does not roll a second resist (Oct 1). Icy Veins: likely mandatory at 60 for PvE.

abilities.name: Improved Fire Ward
abilities.description: Unchanged: Fire Ward has a 10/20% chance to reflect Fire spells.

abilities.name: Heating Up
abilities.description: New row-4 talent requiring Pyroblast; named Hot Streak until Oct 1. Blizzard calls it Forever's take on the old Hot Streak idea. Non-periodic crits with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast and Scorch cut the next Pyroblast's cast by 25%, stacking 3 times (3 stacks = 1.5 s), within 20 s. Fire Blast always adds a charge (a crit gives 2). Not consumed by a Presence of Mind Pyroblast.

abilities.name: Master of Elements
abilities.description: Fire and Frost crits refund 10/20/30% of base mana cost (Frostfire Bolt counts as both). A key mana talent for Fire.

abilities.name: Critical Mass
abilities.description: Oct 15: up to 5 points again, for +10% Fire crit total. Combustion requires 5/5.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.description: No longer requires Pyroblast (official). Wave of flame around the caster plus a 50% Daze for 6 s; damage ~154-184 at talent R1, up to 464-545 at max rank (datamine). Burst AoE and a slow.

abilities.name: Fire Power
abilities.description: Redesigned Oct 15: 3 ranks, +1/2/3% Fire damage per Fire effect you have on the target, up to 12%. Ignite, Improved Scorch, Fireball, Pyroblast and Impact count; mixed-school effects (Frostfire Bolt) give no stack but still benefit.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.description: 31-point capstone; requires 5/5 Critical Mass. Each Fire hit adds +10% Fire crit until 3 non-periodic Fire crits happen. Charges went back to 3 on Oct 1 (beta briefly had 4; Warcraft Tavern still says 4).

abilities.name: Frost Warding
abilities.description: 2 ranks: +15/30% armor and resistances from Frost/Ice Armor; Frost Ward 10/20% chance to negate the warded spell; Ice Barrier and Frost Ward absorb +10/20%.

abilities.name: Improved Frostbolt
abilities.description: -0.1 to -0.5 s cast time on Frostbolt and Frost Blast.

abilities.name: Elemental Precision
abilities.description: Now raises hit with Fire and Frost spells instead of reducing resists (official). Datamine: 3 ranks, +2/4/6% (Icy Veins overview prose says 5%).

abilities.name: Ice Shards
abilities.description: Unchanged: +20-100% crit damage bonus on Frost spells. Applies to Frostfire Bolt (the official 280% crit example uses Ice Shards with Ignite).

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.description: Chill effects have a 5/10/15% chance to Freeze for 5 s. Chance falls with low-rank spells (R1 Frostbolt at 60 = 0%). Oct 15 fix: now procs from Frost/Ice Armor.

abilities.name: Improved Frost Nova
abilities.description: Unchanged: Frost Nova cooldown -2/-4 s. No longer a Shatter prerequisite.

abilities.name: Permafrost
abilities.description: Minor redesign: chill duration +11/22/33% (not +1/2/3 s) and +3-10% extra slow.

abilities.name: Frost Channeling
abilities.description: Moved from row 4 to row 3. -5/10/15% Frost mana cost and -10/20/30% Frost threat (threat part fixed Oct 15).

abilities.name: Improved Blizzard
abilities.description: Slow now caps at 40% instead of 65%, to cut Frost AoE farming of instances by gold farmers and boosters. Datamine: 15/?/40% slow for 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Ice Lance
abilities.description: New 11-point gold medal talent; instant. Low damage, but +200% vs Frozen targets or with Fingers of Frost (cut from 300% on Oct 15). Datamine: talent R1 28-32; spellbook R1 35-41 up to 140-164, ranks listed 28/34/42/48/56. Usable while moving; snapshots Freeze at cast; damage can break Freeze. Replaces Piercing Ice's slot.

abilities.name: Arctic Reach
abilities.description: +10/20% range on Frostbolt, Frost Blast and Blizzard, and +10/20% radius on Frost Nova and Cone of Cold. Wowhead suggests it for PvP/open world.

abilities.name: Ice Block
abilities.description: Moved from row 5 to row 4; now the 16-point gold medal. 10 s immunity to physical attacks and spells; you cannot attack, move or cast. Wowhead: mandatory for PvP, less relevant in PvE; guides use it to drop aggro in dungeons.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: No longer requires Improved Frost Nova (official). Datamine/calculator: 3 ranks, +17/33/50% crit on all your spells vs Frozen targets (Classic: 5 ranks).

abilities.name: Improved Cone of Cold
abilities.description: +12/?/35% Cone of Cold damage (3 ranks).

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.description: Moved from row 3 down to row 5; now the 21-point gold medal. Cooldown raised to 10 min from 5. Finishes the cooldown on all other Frost spells (e.g., Frost Nova, Ice Block, Ice Barrier). Prerequisite for Ice Barrier.

abilities.name: Fingers of Frost
abilities.description: New row-5 talent; Ice Lance is its prerequisite in the calculator/datamine. Chill effects can grant 1/2 charges that make your spells treat the target as Frozen, for Shatter and Ice Lance, even on freeze-immune targets. Datamine: 15% chance, 15 s, applied on cast and consumed by any spell. Guides: with spell batching, one charge can buff two spells.

abilities.name: Winter's Chill
abilities.description: Oct 7: personal only; affects only Frostbolt and Ice Lance. Oct 15 redesign: no longer adds crit. Frostbolt, Frost Blast and Fingers of Frost-empowered Ice Lance get a 20-100% chance to apply a stack (max 5) that raises damage from your next Cone of Cold by 5% and adds 7% of your spell damage; consumed by Cone of Cold. One line in the same notes says '40% increased damage per stack' instead (conflict). No resist roll (Oct 1).

abilities.name: Ice Barrier
abilities.description: 31-point Frost capstone; now requires Cold Snap (not Ice Block). Absorbs damage (calculator 431; spellbook R1 561 + 10% of Frost spell power) and gives +3% Frost damage for 1 min, plus another +3% and no pushback while the shield holds. Further ranks at 46/52/58.

abilities.name: Piercing Ice (removed)
abilities.description: Listed as 'Not in Forever' in the datamined talent comparison (Classic: +2-6% Frost damage). Ice Lance takes its tier.

facts.claim: Frostfire Bolt exists in Forever as a new baseline spell learned at level 40.
facts.evidence: Deep dive: Frostfire Bolt is a new spell learned at level 40.

facts.claim: Frostfire Bolt counts as both a Fire and a Frost spell, so most talents for either school apply; it has a 3 s cast with Fireball-like upfront damage plus a DoT and a slow.
facts.evidence: Official text: counts as both schools; 3-second cast; large upfront damage plus a damage-over-time and slow debuff.

facts.claim: Frostfire Bolt uses the higher of the Mage's Fire or Frost spell damage bonus and the lower of the target's Fire or Frost resistance.
facts.evidence: Official text: always uses the higher spell damage bonus and the lower target resistance of the two schools.

facts.claim: Blizzard designed Frostfire Bolt for hybrid Frost+Fire builds; with Ignite and Ice Shards, a Frostfire Bolt crit deals 200% plus 40% of that as Ignite, 280% total.
facts.evidence: Official example: Ignite plus Ice Shards makes Frostfire Bolt crits total 280%.

facts.claim: Datamined Frostfire Bolt rank 1: 205 mana, 35 yd, 3 s cast, 103-118 Frostfire damage, 40% slow and 27 more damage over 9 s; ranks at 40/50/60.
facts.evidence: Wowhead Forever spellbook datamine (build 1.60.1.70450) tooltip for Frostfire Bolt rank 1.

facts.claim: Icy Veins expects Fire Mages to swap Fireball for Frostfire Bolt from level 40, and its leveling guide says to put points into Frost after Combustion to exploit the double-dipping.
facts.evidence: Guides: Frostfire Bolt replaces Fireball at 40; go into the Frost tree after Combustion for Ice Shards and similar talents.

facts.claim: Arcane Blast was redesigned on Oct 15: 1.5 s cast; each cast grants 15% of Intellect as extra spell damage, stacking 4 times for 15 s; its own mana cost rises per stack; damage was cut 40%.
facts.evidence: Oct 15 dev notes: Arcane Blast redesigned, 1.5 second cast, 15% of Intellect as Spell Damage, lasts 15 seconds.

facts.claim: Missile Barrage moved to the first Arcane row as a 2-point talent; Arcane Missiles hits can now also trigger it.
facts.evidence: Oct 15 notes: Missile Barrage moved to the first row, became 2-point, and Arcane Missiles hits can trigger it.

facts.claim: Arcane Wrath is a new 16-point gold medal Arcane talent: 3.5 s cast, 6 s cooldown, Fireball-like base damage plus bonus spell power equal to 5% of max mana.
facts.evidence: Oct 15 notes: Arcane Wrath, new 16-point gold medal talent, 3.5 second cast, 6 second cooldown.

facts.claim: Heating Up (renamed from Hot Streak on Oct 1): non-periodic crits from Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast and Scorch each cut the next Pyroblast's cast by 25%, stacking 3 times to a 1.5 s Pyroblast.
facts.evidence: Official: each crit reduces next Pyroblast cast by 25%, stacking 3 times; at 3 stacks Pyroblast is 1.5 seconds.

facts.claim: Fire Blast always adds an extra Heating Up charge, so a Fire Blast crit gives 2 charges; Heating Up is not consumed by a Presence of Mind Pyroblast.
facts.evidence: Oct 15 notes: Fire Blast critical strikes generate 2 Heating Up charges.

facts.claim: The 'Wake of Fire' talent (Fire Blast crit bonus after kills) was reverted to Improved Fire Blast on Oct 15. Guide prose that still describes Wake of Fire is outdated.
facts.evidence: Oct 15 notes: Wake of Fire reverted to Improved Fire Blast; no bonus on kills; +8/15 yards Fire Blast range.

facts.claim: Combustion returned to 3 charges (it was briefly 4 in the beta).
facts.evidence: Oct 1 notes: Combustion charges returned to 3 (was 4).

facts.claim: Ignite is now a separate debuff for each Mage rather than one shared Ignite, which fixes threat and damage attribution.
facts.evidence: Official: Ignite now a unique debuff per Mage caster; Classic Era Mages shared a single Ignite.

facts.claim: Ice Lance is a new 11-point gold medal Frost talent: instant, low base damage, and its bonus vs Frozen targets was cut to +200% (from 300%) on Oct 15.
facts.evidence: Oct 15 notes: Ice Lance damage against Frozen targets changed to a 200% increase (was 300%).

facts.claim: Fingers of Frost is new: Chill effects can grant 1 or 2 charges that make your spells treat the target as Frozen. Datamine: 15% chance, lasts 15 s.
facts.evidence: Official: Chill effects have a chance to grant 1/2 charges; spells treat target as if Frozen.

facts.claim: Shatter no longer requires Improved Frost Nova; the calculator shows 3 ranks giving +50% crit vs Frozen targets.
facts.evidence: Official: Shatter no longer requires Improved Frost Nova. Calculator: 3 ranks, 50%.

facts.claim: Ice Block is now the Frost 16-point gold medal talent, and Cold Snap is the 21-point gold medal with a 10-minute cooldown (was 5).
facts.evidence: Official: Ice Block 16-point gold medal; Cold Snap 21-point gold medal, cooldown increased to 10 minutes.

facts.claim: Winter's Chill was redesigned: it no longer adds crit and instead stacks (max 5) to empower your next Cone of Cold. Dev notes give two different numbers: 5% + 7% of spell damage per stack, or 40% per stack.
facts.evidence: Oct 15 notes: Winter's Chill redesigned, no longer increases critical strike chance; empowers next Cone of Cold.

facts.claim: Cone of Cold's duration was cut to stop gold farmers and boosters kiting big packs; on Oct 15 the first 4 targets regained an extra 10% slow and 3 s duration.
facts.evidence: Notes: reduced for controlling massive numbers of targets; reasonable to retain power against 4 or fewer targets.

facts.claim: Improved Blizzard's slow now caps at 40% instead of 65%, to reduce Frost Mage AoE farming of instances.
facts.evidence: Official: Improved Blizzard now maxes out at a 40% Slow instead of 65%, to reduce AoE farming.

facts.claim: Down-ranking is penalized: spells far below your level get less spell-damage benefit and lower proc chances; Rank 1 Frostbolt at level 60 has a 0% Frostbite chance.
facts.evidence: Oct 1 notes: Rank 1 Frostbolt at level 60 will result in a 0% chance to get a Frostbite activation.

facts.claim: Frost Blast is a new level-24 spell: 1.5 s cast, 40% slow, affected by all Frostbolt talents; it replaces the old down-ranked Rank 1 Frostbolt.
facts.evidence: Oct 15 notes: Frost Blast learned at 24, provides functionality formerly granted by Rank 1 Frostbolt.

facts.claim: Comprehension is a new Mage-only minor tradeskill for deciphering scrolls dropped by creatures, used through the Comprehend Scroll ability in the General spellbook tab.
facts.evidence: Official: Comprehension lets Mages read and decipher scrolls dropped by creatures; Comprehend Scroll in General tab.

facts.claim: Comprehend Scroll is learned at level 6. Deciphered scrolls give 1-hour weapon imbues (e.g., Imbue Frost, Imbue Lesser Flame), +Intellect familiars (Rat/Frog/Cat), damage consumables (Cryoblast), utility (Khadgar's Unlocking, opens locks up to 125) and weapon-creation scrolls (Scroll of the Saber leads to Coldflame Saber).
facts.evidence: Method.gg (beta) lists scroll tiers at Comprehension 1/15/50/175 with imbue, familiar, Cryoblast and unlocking effects.

facts.claim: Failing to decipher a scroll turns the Mage into a sheep; turning books in to libraries unlocks Research, which lets a Mage create a Bundle of Scrolls once an hour inside a library.
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern: a failed decipher turns you into a sheep; Research creates a Bundle of Scrolls hourly in a library.

facts.claim: Comprehension scrolls cannot be used while moving (Oct 1) and trigger the global cooldown (Oct 15).
facts.evidence: Notes: Mage scrolls can no longer be cast while moving; Scrolls now incur a global cooldown.

facts.claim: Conjure Water and Conjure Food now make 20 items per cast instead of 10.
facts.evidence: Wowhead datamine: max-rank Conjure Water conjures 20 bottles (Classic 10).

facts.claim: Teleports to faction capitals come at 20, Darnassus/Thunder Bluff at 30, Portals at 40 and 50, and a new Teleport: Dalaran at 50; city Portal Trainers teach them.
facts.evidence: Wowhead datamine lists Teleport level 20/30, Portal level 40/50, new Teleport: Dalaran level 50.

facts.claim: With fast travel limited in Forever, Mage portals are the fastest way to travel and players often tip for them; the Legacy talent Reagent Economy makes teleports and portals free.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: portals are the fastest travel, players tip; Reagent Economy makes all Mage Teleports and Portals free.

facts.claim: Remove Lesser Curse (level 18) now removes a Curse or a Bane, so the Mage is still a party decurser.
facts.evidence: Wowhead datamine: removes 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target (Classic: removes 1 Curse).

facts.claim: Arcane Brilliance is trainable at 56 and now buffs the whole raid, not just the party.
facts.evidence: Wowhead datamine: infuses the target's party and raid; Classic was party only.

facts.claim: Detect Magic is removed; Flamestrike is now limited to one active per Mage.
facts.evidence: Wowhead datamine marks Detect Magic not in Forever; Flamestrike tooltip adds a one-per-Mage restriction.

facts.claim: Mage Armor's Spirit-based mana regen bonus was increased; the datamine shows 50% of regen continuing while casting (Classic 30%), learned at 34.
facts.evidence: Official: Mage Armor mana regeneration bonus from Spirit increased.

facts.claim: Arcane Meditation goes up to 50% regen while casting; Wowhead says that with Mage Armor, Arcane reaches 100% regen during casts.
facts.evidence: Wowhead L30: once Mage Armor arrives, Arcane goes up to full mana regeneration during casts.

facts.claim: Mana is a constant leveling bottleneck: casting pauses regen for 5 s (the 5-second rule), and guides say leveling speed depends on drinking downtime more than spell damage.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: leveling pace is set by downtime spent drinking, not how hard spells hit.

facts.claim: Wands no longer gain damage from spell damage (Sept 24) and need a 0.5 s stand-still before shooting (Oct 15); guides still call wands strong while leveling to about 30.
facts.evidence: Notes: Wands no longer gain any additional damage from the user's spell damage.

facts.claim: Mana tools: Evocation (level 20, 8 min cooldown, 8 s channel at +1500% regen), mana gems from 28 (Agate) to 58 (Ruby), Clearcasting, Master of Elements (30% refund on Fire/Frost crits), Frost Channeling (-15% Frost cost) and free Missile Barrage Arcane Missiles.
facts.evidence: Wowhead datamine tooltips for Evocation, Conjure Mana Agate/Jade/Citrine/Ruby and talents.

facts.claim: Blizzard's intent is for each school to play more actively moment-to-moment, choosing the right spell for the moment, with more room for cross-school builds.
facts.evidence: Deep dive heading: building around the right spell at the right time; stronger school identities, cross-school builds.

facts.claim: Icy Veins says the Mage keeps a manageable rotation with no especially difficult timings; the new procs add spice without overcomplicating the class.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins overview: Mage remains a solid high-DPS caster with a manageable rotation and no difficult timings.

facts.claim: Arcane's mana management is described as an extra layer of complexity the other two Mage specs lack; Fire reportedly reacts to crits rather than repeating one cast.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: Fire gets more moments reacting to what just happened instead of repeating the same cast.

facts.claim: Beta players found level-30 Arcane underwhelming to play: Arcane Blast felt unfun, and Missile Barrage could still fail to proc after 4 Blasts (about 12%), though Arcane Explosion AoE felt strong.
facts.evidence: Wowhead L30: Arcane feels underwhelming in playstyle; Arcane Explosion AoE feels great.

facts.claim: Level-30 Fire felt very weak in the beta because crit chance is scarce; it has the slowest pacing of the three, and Heating Up did not feel fluid.
facts.evidence: Wowhead L30: Fire feels extremely weak due to lack of crit; Heating Up does not feel fluid yet.

facts.claim: Frost is reported as the strongest level-30 beta build and the traditional leveling spec, but it still relies on RNG procs.
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern: Frost is the strongest level-30 build, Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost key, still RNG-dependent.

facts.claim: Icy Veins calls Arcane a viable, promising leveling spec for the first time, and says AoE grinding is mostly a thing of the past in Forever.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins Arcane leveling: AoE grinding is mostly gone; Arcane leveling isn't just viable, it's promising.

facts.claim: Spells are weaker by default in Forever but scale better with spell power, which is more common on gear even at low levels.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: damage spells weaker by default, scale better with Spell Power made more abundant on gear.

facts.claim: Level 20 is the big power spike: Blink, Evocation, Mana Shield, Blizzard, Fire Ward, capital teleports and the 11-point talents (Arcane Blast / Pyroblast / Ice Lance).
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern unlock table lists Mana Shield, Fire Ward, Evocation, Blink, Teleport at 20.

facts.claim: Talents start at level 10 with one-point milestone talents at 11, 16 (new), 21 and 31 points; Dual Specialization unlocks at 40; you respec at a class trainer in a major city.
facts.evidence: Official: milestone talents at 11, 21 and 31 points joined by a new 16-point milestone; Dual Specialization at 40.

facts.claim: No level-60 Mage rotation or raid guide exists yet; Icy Veins says it cannot give suggestions beyond the beta cap of 30.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: cannot offer gear or leveling suggestions beyond the beta level cap of 30.

facts.claim: A speculative level-60 Frost priority from wowtbc.gg: Mage Armor, keep Ice Barrier up, Cone of Cold at 5 Winter's Chill, Ice Lance on Fingers of Frost, keep 1 Arcane Blast stack, Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage, Frostbolt filler.
facts.evidence: wowtbc.gg: sims will eventually decide the optimal rotation; this is an idea of what it might look like.

facts.claim: Icy Veins expects Improved Scorch to be mandatory for Fire PvE at 60, and says spell hit becomes much more important at 60 against raid bosses.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: Improved Scorch will likely be mandatory at level 60 for PvE.

facts.claim: Wowhead notes Arcane runs out of useful talents, with about 18 spare points in a full level-60 tree, which pushes hybrid builds.
facts.evidence: Wowhead L30: a complete level 60 Arcane tree leaves nearly 18 points with nothing to spend on.

facts.claim: In dungeons, Mages are expected to Polymorph, Counterspell ranged mobs, AoE (Arcane Explosion near a Paladin tank, Flamestrike pre-cast, Blizzard), watch threat, and supply food, water and Arcane Intellect.
facts.evidence: Wowhead L30: use Counterspell to kick ranged mobs in dungeons; AoE pairs well with Paladin tanks.

facts.claim: Forever has no Arenas; Mage PvP happens in battlegrounds (Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, new Darkspear Islands, Alterac Valley) and on PvP-ruleset world servers.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins PvP overview: no Arena in Forever; battlegrounds include new Darkspear Islands.

facts.claim: Frost is called the main PvP spec; Wowhead calls Ice Block mandatory and Cold Snap near-mandatory for PvP, and Icy Veins calls Improved Counterspell essential for PvP and Impact essential for Fire PvP.
facts.evidence: Wowhead L30: if you plan to PvP, Ice Block is a mandatory talent point.

facts.claim: Orc (Horde) and Skyborne (Alliance) can now be Mages, alongside Human, Gnome, Troll and Undead; Dwarf Mages are not available.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: newly playable Mage races are Skyborne (Alliance) and Orc (Horde); no Dwarf Mage.

facts.claim: At level 30 a class quest chain (requires Scarlet Monastery: Library) rewards one school wand: Icefury Wand, Ragefire Wand or Nether Force Wand.
facts.evidence: Wowhead L30: Mage's Wand quest chain ends with a choice of Icefury, Ragefire or Nether Force Wand.

facts.claim: Icy Veins reports Mages still have some of the best AoE farming, with no damage falloff by target count; Warcraft Tavern says AoE grinding seems toned down.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins Frost leveling: Mages have some of the best AoE farming; AoE has no target-count falloff but is expensive.

levelingNotes:
Levels 1-10 (no talents): Fireball, Frost Armor and Arcane Intellect at 1; Conjure Water at 4; Frostbolt at 4 becomes the main spell; Fire Blast and Conjure Food at 6, plus Comprehend Scroll (scrolls start dropping); Polymorph and Arcane Missiles at 8; Frost Nova at 10. Guides say the early game is kiting with Frostbolt slows, finishing with the wand (wands are disproportionately strong through the 20s), and constant drinking. You pick a spec at 10 (talents start then). Missile Barrage is now a row-1 talent; the Frost leveling guide recommends grabbing it early whatever your spec.

Levels 10-20: Arcane Explosion at 14, Flamestrike at 16, Remove Lesser Curse and Amplify Magic at 18. Level 20 is the big spike: Blink, Evocation, Mana Shield, Fire Ward, Blizzard, capital teleports, and the 11-point talents (Arcane Blast, Pyroblast or Ice Lance).

Levels 20-30: Scorch at 22; Frost Blast and Counterspell at 24; Cone of Cold at 26; Mana Agate at 28; Ice Armor, Darnassus/Thunder Bluff teleports, the 21-point talents (Fingers of Frost, Blast Wave, Presence of Mind) and the class wand quest at 30. Beta verdict at 30:
- Frost is strongest, safe and consistent, but RNG and mana-hungry.
- Arcane is mana-hungry; its single-target play feels underwhelming, but Arcane Explosion AoE is strong (Wowhead).
- Fire feels weak until it gets crit gear (Wowhead), though it scales well later.
Guides agree mana downtime defines pacing more than damage. Dungeon quests give big XP.

Levels 30-60 (beyond the beta, so from datamine and official tables only): Mage Armor at 34 greatly cuts downtime (50% regen while casting; with Arcane Meditation, Arcane reaches 100%). Level 40 brings Frostfire Bolt, portals, Dual Specialization, the first mount (Apprentice Riding) and the 31-point capstones (Arcane Power, Combustion, Ice Barrier). Teleport: Dalaran (Wowhead says 50, Icy Veins 40), Darnassus/Thunder Bluff portals at 50, Arcane Brilliance (raid-wide) at 56, final spell ranks at 60. Mass AoE kiting was deliberately weakened (shorter Cone of Cold, 40% Improved Blizzard cap, down-rank penalties), but guides still say AoE with a partner or in groups is strong. No source describes what play feels like at 60.
groupRoleNotes:
Every spec is ranged magic DPS; there is no tank or heal role. Duties reported by guides and supported by the spellbook:
1. Crowd control: Polymorph (1.5 s cast, 30 yd, up to 50 s, Beasts/Humanoids/Critters, one target per Mage; groups mark sheep with the crescent moon). Frost Nova (10 yd freeze, 25 s cooldown) for emergencies and to let the party escape. Slows from Cone of Cold, Blizzard (with talent), Frostbolt, Frost Blast and Blast Wave.
2. Interrupts: Counterspell (level 24, 30 s cooldown, locks the school for 10 s, high threat). Improved Counterspell always adds a 2/4 s Silence.
3. Dispel: Remove Lesser Curse (level 18) removes a Curse or a Bane. The Mage is a decurser, but has no magic, poison or disease removal.
4. AoE: Arcane Explosion is the core group AoE for all specs, best with a Paladin tank holding threat (Wowhead). Pre-cast Flamestrike; Blizzard from range; Fire's Flamestrike plus Blast Wave is the strongest burst AoE. Big pulls risk aggro, and guides warn not to AoE fewer than 3-4 mobs because of mana.
5. Threat and defensives: Ice Block (Frost), Ice Barrier (Frost 31-point), Mana Shield; talents like Arcane Subtlety, Burning Soul and Frost Channeling reduce threat.
6. Group utility: conjured food and water (20 per cast, tradeable), Arcane Intellect (Arcane Brilliance raid-wide at 56), Amplify/Dampen Magic, mana gems, portals for the group (fastest travel in Forever), and Comprehension scroll buffs for the Mage and allies.
7. Mana: use Evocation regularly in dungeons and raids.
Raids at launch: Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20), Onyxia's Lair (40); no world buffs inside. No level-60 raid duties or rankings are published yet; Icy Veins tier lists say 'coming soon'.
pvpNotes:
There are no Arenas. PvP is battlegrounds (Warsong Gulch 10-60, Arathi Basin 20-60, new Darkspear Islands 30-60, Alterac Valley 51-60), world PvP on the PvP ruleset (zones above 15 are contested), and a seasonal Rank Point system with Honor/Marks gear. Official Oct 8 note: crits in PvP no longer have reduced efficacy.

Mage PvP in sources:
- Frost is the main PvP spec (Warcraft Tavern). Icy Veins Frost leveling calls it great in PvP; Wowhead says Frost is a lot safer and you can actually PvP.
- Wowhead: Ice Block is mandatory and Cold Snap near-mandatory for PvP/open world; Arctic Reach and Improved Frost Nova are PvP/open-world picks.
- Icy Veins: Improved Counterspell (now a guaranteed 2/4 s Silence) is essential for PvP; Impact (Fire stun) is essential for Fire PvP; Arcane Subtlety (spell penetration) is mostly for PvP. Icy Veins Fire leveling lists 'vulnerable in PvP' as a weakness.
- Toolkit: Blink (breaks stuns and roots), Polymorph, Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Ice Lance and Fire Blast (instant damage on the move), Mana Shield, Fire/Frost Ward.
- Racials: Human Will to Survive/Perception, Gnome Escape Artist/Eureka!, Orc Shatter Curse (now dispels Curses/Banes)/Hardiness, Undead Will of the Forsaken, Skyborne Walk on Air.
No Mage-specific PvP guide or ranking exists yet.
openQuestions: No level-60 rotation or raid guidance exists for any Mage spec (beta capped at 30). Raid rotation variety and repetitiveness at 60 is unknown; the only 60 priority is wowtbc.gg's speculative Frost list.
Winter's Chill: the Oct 15 dev notes contradict themselves ('40% increased damage per stack' vs '5% plus 7% of spell damage per stack'). The datamine matches the 5%/7% text.

Arcane Blast after the Oct 15 redesign: the tooltip only says it grants 15% of Intellect as spell damage per stack for 15 s. Older guide text (Icy Veins, Wowhead) still describes a +10% per stack buff to the next non-Blast spell, now superseded. Guides have not yet re-tested the Arcane loop with Arcane Wrath.

Icy Veins class overview and Fire prose still describe 'Wake of Fire' and 'Hot Streak', and Warcraft Tavern says Combustion lasts 4 crits. All are superseded by official dev notes (Improved Fire Blast; Heating Up; 3 charges).
Cooldowns not stated in any Forever source: Ice Block, Presence of Mind, Arcane Power, Combustion (Classic 1.12: 5 min / 3 min / 3 min / 3 min). Mana gem cooldown also not stated.

Ice Lance level: the talent is reachable at 20 (11-point), but the Wowhead spellbook lists trainable ranks at 28/34/42/48/56 and says 'trained at level 28'. Arcane Wrath ranks are listed at 36/48/60 although the talent is reachable at 25.
Teleport: Dalaran level conflicts: 50 (Wowhead datamine) vs 40 (Icy Veins Frost leveling table).
What baseline Magic Attunement does in Forever is not described anywhere.
Talent ranks marked '?' in the datamine (e.g., Improved Blizzard rank 2, Improved Cone of Cold rank 2) were not captured.
Full Comprehension scroll list, the higher-tier (175+) scrolls, Scroll of Liminal Passage's effect, and whether scroll effects change at launch (they got a balance pass Oct 1) are uncertain.

How strong Frostfire Bolt hybrid builds are at 60 vs pure Fire or Frost; whether Fire actually replaces Fireball, and how Frostfire Bolt interacts with Fingers of Frost, Shatter and Winter's Chill (it is not listed as a Winter's Chill applier).
Whether Frost will stay the strongest leveling spec after the Oct 15 Ice Lance nerf (300% to 200%) and the Cone of Cold buff.
The bonus amounts for Mage Armor and Arcane Meditation are not given officially; only datamined percentages are known.
The Mobalytics projected level-60 Fire talent tree is built on an outdated beta tree (Fire Power 5 ranks, Elemental Precision 5 ranks), so it is unreliable.
